To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the UMVUE of the variance of an inverse Gaussian random variable is not admissible, and that the maximum likelihood estimator of the variance is dominated by a linear combination of the maximum likelihood estimators of the parameters of the distribution.

the uniformly minimum variance biased estimator of the inverse gamma parameter is the maximum likelihood estimator of that parameter and that the uniformly minimum mean squared error unbiased estimator of the variance of an inverse gamma random variable is the maximum likelihood estimate of that variance.

(i) the UMVUE of the inverse Gaussian parameter is inadmissible in a certain sense, (ii) there is a dominating estimator of the variance parameter, (iii) there are estimators dominating the UMVUE and MLE of the other parameters, (iv) the UMVU estimators of the inverse Gaussian parameters are not inadmissible in the class of all estimators
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of dominating estimators to MLE's of various parameters of the inverse Gaussian distributions.
the admissibility or inadmissibility of estimators for the variance, the mean, the mean deviation and the coefficient of variation of the inverse Gaussian distributions.
the admissibility of estimators of parameters of the inverse Gaussian (IG) distribution.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MLE's of all parameters are inadmissible, except for the MLE of the mean which is admissible.
the inverse Gaussian distribution has no good estimators.
the MLE is inadmissible for the variance of the IG distribution and that there are dominating estimators for all the parameters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have given dominating estimators to the estimators of all the parameters of the inverse Gaussian.
the UMVUE of the variance and the MLE's of the other parameters are inadmissible.
the MLE of the variance is inadmissible, but that of the other parameters is not.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MLE's of all the parameters of the inverse Gaussian are not admissible.
inadmissibility of estimators is not restricted to the exponential family.
the UMVUE of the variance is not necessarily the best estimator.
